highlights.description: Initial release — a domain-neutral model that normalizes findings across security, accessibility (a11y), internationalization (i18n), and quality engineering (qe) into one canonical `Finding` with a typed, per-type `Detail` subsection
Two-level `Domain` + `Type` taxonomy with ingest adapters for open-source scanners: gitleaks, axe-core, and govulncheck in-repo (Grype, Trivy, and AWS Inspector via their tool libraries)
Call-graph reachability (via govulncheck) as a first-class prioritization signal, and a canonical container/SCA package-vulnerability shape shared by Grype, Trivy, and Inspector

added.description: `findingspec`: canonical `Finding` and `FindingSet` with domain/severity/open filtering, counting, severity ordering, and a `Summary` analytics rollup

`findingspec`: shared vocabulary — `Severity` (via the priority-frameworks Severity framework), `Status`, `Confidence`, `Domain`, `Source`, `Location` (code, runtime, or RFC 6901 JSON Pointer), `Evidence`, `Remediation`, `Reference`

`security`: `Vulnerability` with inherent vs. residual severity, compensating controls, and exception-driven effective severity; `Secret`; `CVSS`; `Package`/`Fix`/`Artifact` for SCA and container scans; and call-graph `Reachability`
`a11y`: WCAG `Issue` with conformance level and impact-to-severity mapping
`qe`: quality-engineering `Failure` for end-to-end and user-journey findings
`adapters/gitleaks`: secret-scan JSON report to security/secret findings, with redaction and provider/kind inference
`adapters/axe`: axe-core results JSON to a11y/wcag findings, one per element, with WCAG criterion/level parsed from tags
`adapters/govulncheck`: `govulncheck -json` to security/sca findings, deriving call-graph reachability (state, vulnerable symbol, example call paths)

documentation.description: Project specs: PRD, TRD, and roadmap
README and MkDocs (Material) documentation site covering the finding model, severity, domains, interchange/adapters, and reference

highlights.description: Security findings can now carry root cause, product impact, exploit notes, verification, typed relationships to work items and fixes, and a disclosure lifecycle, so one record spans discovery, engineering fix, and product impact

added.description: `findingspec`: typed `Relationship` links (threat, control, requirement, tracking item, fix, test, duplicate) and `Verification` on `Finding`
`security`: `RootCause`, `Impact`, `Exploit`, and `Publication` (visibility, disclosure state, GHSA/CVE/OSV/Go vulnerability IDs, affected version ranges) on `Vulnerability` and its `Detail`
